title.zh: 修正第一百七十五号法案第四条的法案，该法案题为《关于组建与管理岛屿宪兵队及市政警察检查的法案》，经修订后规定：当菲律宾宪兵队成员经有管辖权法院（宪兵队简易法庭除外）定罪并判刑时，宪兵队首长可命令将其不名誉退伍，并没收其所有应得或即将到期的薪金与津贴
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION FOUR OF ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-FIVE, ENTITLED "AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ORGANIZATION AND GOVERNMENT OF AN INSULAR CONSTABULARY AND FOR THE INSPECTION OF THE MUNICIPAL POLICE," AS AMENDED, BY PROVIDING THAT WHEN A MEMBER OF THE PHILIPPINES CONSTABULARY HAS BEEN CONVICTED AND SENTENCED BY A COURT OF COMPETENT JURISDICTION, OTHER THAN A CONSTABULARY SUMMARY COURT, THE CHIEF OF CONSTABULARY MAY ORDER HIS DISHONORABLE DISCHARGE AND THE FORFEITURE OF ALL PAY AND ALLOWANCES DUE OR TO BECOME DUE.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION FOUR OF ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-FIVE, ENTITLED "AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ORGANIZATION AND GOVERNMENT OF AN INSULAR CONSTABULARY AND FOR THE INSPECTION OF THE MUNICIPAL POLICE," AS AMENDED, BY PROVIDING THAT WHEN A MEMBER OF THE PHILIPPINES CONSTABULARY HAS BEEN CONVICTED AND SENTENCED BY A COURT OF COMPETENT JURISDICTION, OTHER THAN A CONSTABULARY SUMMARY COURT, THE CHIEF OF CONSTABULARY MAY ORDER HIS DISHONORABLE DISCHARGE AND THE FORFEITURE OF ALL PAY AND ALLOWANCES DUE OR TO BECOME DUE.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Điều 4 của Đạo luật số Một Trăm Bảy Mươi Năm, nhan đề 'Đạo luật quy định việc tổ chức và quản lý lực lượng cảnh sát đảo và kiểm tra cảnh sát đô thị', sau khi được sửa đổi, bằng cách quy định rằng khi một thành viên lực lượng cảnh sát Philippines bị tòa án có thẩm quyền kết án và tuyên phạt, trừ tòa án sơ thẩm cảnh sát, thì Trưởng lực lượng cảnh sát có thể ra lệnh cho người đó xuất ngũ không danh dự và tịch thu toàn bộ tiền lương và phụ cấp đã hoặc sẽ được hưởng
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขมาตรา 4 แห่งพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่หนึ่งร้อยเจ็ดสิบห้า ซึ่งมีชื่อว่า “พระราชบัญญัติว่าด้วยการจัดตั้งและการปกครองกองกำลังตำรวจเกาะ และการตรวจสอบตำรวจเทศบาล” ตามที่ได้แก้ไขแล้ว โดยกำหนดให้เมื่อสมาชิกกองกำลังตำรวจฟิลิปปินส์ถูกพิพากษาลงโทษและตัดสินจำคุกโดยศาลที่มีเขตอำนาจตามกฎหมาย ยกเว้นศาลทหารตำรวจสรุป หัวหน้ากองกำลังตำรวจอาจสั่งปลดออกจากงานอย่างไม่มีเกียรติ และยึดเงินเดือนและเงินประจำตำแหน่งทั้งหมดที่ได้รับหรือจะได้รับ
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Pasal 4 Undang-Undang Nomor Seratus Tujuh Puluh Lima, berjudul 'Undang-Undang tentang Organisasi dan Pemerintahan Kepolisian Insuler serta Pemeriksaan Kepolisian Kota', sebagaimana telah diubah, dengan menetapkan bahwa apabila anggota Kepolisian Filipina telah dihukum dan dijatuhi hukuman oleh pengadilan yang berwenang, selain dari pengadilan ringkas kepolisian, maka Kepala Kepolisian dapat memerintahkan pemberhentiannya secara tidak hormat serta penyitaan seluruh gaji dan tunjangan yang telah atau akan menjadi haknya
title.ms: Akta Mengubah Seksyen 4 Akta Nombor Seratus Tujuh Puluh Lima, bertajuk “Akta Mengenai Penubuhan dan Pentadbiran Polis Kepulauan serta Pemeriksaan Polis Bandar”, sebagaimana telah diubah, dengan menetapkan bahawa apabila ahli Polis Filipina telah dihukum dan dijatuhkan hukuman oleh mahkamah yang berkuasa, selain daripada mahkamah ringkas polis, Ketua Polis boleh memerintahkan pemecatannya secara tidak bermaruah dan perampasan semua gaji dan elaun yang telah atau akan menjadi haknya

text.en:
Section four of Act Numbered One hundred and seventy-five, entitled "An Act providing for the
organization and government of an Insular Constabulary, and for the inspection of the municipal police," as
amended, is hereby further amended by substituting a semicolon for the period after the words "United
States" in the twenty-fourth line of said section, and inserting after said semicolon the following words: "and
when a member of the Philippines Constabulary has been convicted and sentenced by a court of competent
jurisdiction, other than a Constabulary summary court, the Chief of Constabulary may order his dishonorable
discharge and the forfeiture of all pay and allowances due or to become due;" so that said complete sentence
in said section shall read as follows: "The Insular Chief is also given authority to suspend and, after clue
hearing, to remove, any provincial inspector or other member of the Insular Constabulary for inefficiency,
misconduct, or disloyalty to the United States and when a member of the Philippines Constabulary has been
convicted and sentenced by a court of competent jurisdiction, other than a Constabulary summary court, the
Chief of Constabulary may order his dishonorable discharge and the forfeiture of all pay and allowances due
or to become due."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.

Enacted, March 22, 1904.
